subject.title: [Bug] Silent fail-open when Tailscale interface binding fails on gateway start

question: Should an explicitly configured `gateway.bind="tailnet"` fail gateway startup when no Tailscale IPv4 address is available, or preserve the released loopback availability fallback?
rationale: Failing closed best matches explicit configuration and documentation, but it changes released startup behavior and can make gateways unavailable during temporary Tailscale failures.

options.title: Fail explicit tailnet closed
options.body: Reject startup with a clear diagnostic for explicit `tailnet`, while leaving fallback selection to `auto`.

options.title: Preserve fallback with warning
options.body: Continue binding loopback but emit prominent startup, status, and audit diagnostics and update the documented contract.

recommendation.title: Fail explicit tailnet closed
recommendation.body: Reject startup with a clear diagnostic for explicit `tailnet`, while leaving fallback selection to `auto`.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue has already been routed to steipete for this gateway security and compatibility policy choice.
